# Actor reviews

By reviewing and rating an Actor, you help other users understand how it performs. You can also let a developer know how they can improve their Actor.

## Check Actor's reviews

To see how other users rate and review a specific Actor:

1. Navigate to the Actor's page in [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store).
2. Select the **Reviews** tab.

![Reviews tab in Apify Store](/assets/images/actor_reviews-5f6b4ce26c3643f6f5dd04fdfdf1d05e.svg)

### Add a review

To share your opinion of an Actor:

1. Navigate to the Actor's page in [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store).

2. Select the **Reviews** tab.

3. Under the Actor's rating, you have two options:

   <!-- -->

   * To only rate the Actor, use the star rating.
   * To rate and review the Actor, select **Write review**.

If you have a problem with the Actor that you're reviewing, consider [opening an issue](https://docs.apify.com/actors/running/actors-in-store.md#report-issues-with-actors).

### Edit a review

If you only rated the Actor, you can later change that rating and add a review.

If you rated the Actor and wrote a review, you can't edit either of those.

### Delete a review

If you decide your review is no longer relevant, you can delete it:

1. Navigate to the Actor's page in [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store).
2. Select the **Reviews** tab.
3. On your review, select **Options** > **Delete**.

## Report a review

You can report reviews that don't follow the community standards. The support team verifies all reports and deletes reviews that violate Apify policies.

To report a review:

1. On a review, select **Options** > **Report**.
2. In **Reason for reporting**, select the right category from a dropdown list.
3. *(Optional)* In **Additional details**, add a comment to the report.
4. Select **Submit**.

### Reasons for reporting a review

When reporting a review, select one of the following reasons:

* **Hate speech or offensive language**. For example, review offends the Actor developer, Apify community, or uses foul language.
* **False or misleading information**. For example, review contains false information about the Actor's pricing.
* **Spam or irrelevant content**. For example, review is an ad for another Actor or product.
* **Harassment or abusive behavior**. For example, review contains abusive or threatening language.
* **Other**. For example, review is not related to the Actor or the Apify platform.
